description_en: Modifies the status of sensitive files in an image
description_zh: 设置镜像敏感文件的状态
kebab_example: aliyun sas set-image-sensitive-file-status --sensitive-file-key pem --image-uuids f382fccd88b94c5c8c864def6815b854,ac32fccd88b94c5c8c864def6815bo9z --status 0 --scan-range image --id-list 123 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
